description_expanded: Enjoy Gulf views and easy beach access from this raised Inlet Beach vacation home, thoughtfully designed for up to nine guests. Positioned just across the dunes from the sugar-white shoreline, the home offers a bright, coastal setting where sea breezes and sparkling water views are part of the everyday experience. Multiple balconies and expansive windows create a strong connection to the surrounding beachscape, while the nearby beach access boardwalk makes it easy to spend your days on the sand. Guests consistently appreciate the home's unique combination of convenience and privacy, enjoying a peaceful setting that still feels remarkably close to the Gulf. The main living area at Inlet Beach Dream  features an open-concept layout filled with natural light. Crisp white interiors, tile flooring, and comfortable seating create a relaxed gathering space for reconnecting after a day at the beach. Large windows frame partial Gulf views, while the adjacent dining area enjoys a sunny corner setting with glimpses of the water beyond. The kitchen is bright and functional with white cabinetry, generous counter space, and full-size appliances, making it easy to prepare everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners. A full hall bath and laundry area on this level add everyday convenience, while the spacious layout provides plenty of room for families to spread out and relax. The spacious third-floor Primary Suite serves as a peaceful retreat, offering a king bed, vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and Gulf views. A full-over-twin bunk provides additional sleeping space on this level, making it especially convenient for families. Above, the fourth-floor loft bedroom features a queen bed, a private balcony with Gulf views, and a bathroom with a walk-in shower. Together with the queen sleeper sofa in the living room, the home comfortably accommodates up to nine guests, with the added convenience of a bathroom on every living level. On the ground level, covered parking and outdoor gathering space offer added convenience after a day on the beach. A picnic table provides a casual spot for outdoor meals, while the outdoor shower makes it easy to rinse away sand before heading inside. From here, beach access is only about a 2-minute walk via the nearby boardwalk, making spontaneous beach trips effortless throughout your stay. Beyond the beach, guests are just minutes from the shops, dining, and entertainment of 30Avenue and the charming coastal community of Rosemary Beach . Several past guests have highlighted how easy it is to reach nearby restaurants, boutiques, and attractions by bike or car while still enjoying the quieter atmosphere of Inlet Beach . Nature lovers will appreciate nearby Camp Helen State Park , where scenic trails, coastal dune lake views, fishing, paddleboarding, and abundant wildlife create memorable outdoor adventures. Whether you're spending your days on the beach, exploring local attractions, or simply enjoying the Gulf views from the balcony, this Inlet Beach getaway offers a welcoming home base for a relaxing stay along Scenic Highway 30A. First Floor: Entryway with Foyer. Second Floor: Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry. Third Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Full-over-Twin Bunk and Tub/Shower Combo. Fourth Floor: Queen Loft Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access.
rooms_guidance: Total: Queen, King, Full/Twin Bunk, Queen Sleeper Sofa
